Rules and architecture that span terms and tables.

# Concepts

* [GCP project map](gcp-project-map.md) - Which GCP project holds which data, where Dataform runs, and how the vault points back to BigQuery.
* [Knowledge layers](knowledge-layers.md) - The vault has three layers. Glossary says what things mean, pipeline says where the data physically is, brain says how to use both.
* [Metric additivity](metric-additivity.md) - Which numbers can be summed, which only within a slice, and which must be recomputed. The most common source of wrong answers from people and agents.
* [One owner per fact](one-owner-per-fact.md) - Every fact is edited in exactly one place. Every other appearance is compiled from it and never edited by hand.
